subject.title: Redesign Overview as an operator-first OpenClaw dashboard

question: Should #86460 remain the candidate Overview dashboard direction, or should only its provider-native quota/OpenRouter pieces be extracted after repair?
rationale: Both #86460 and #77774 redesign the Overview dashboard, while #86460 is draft/conflicting and still has provider-usage blockers; automation cannot choose the permanent product direction or prove the contributor's live OpenRouter setup.

options.title: Keep #86460 As Candidate After Repair
options.body: Keep this PR open but require rebase, the two provider-usage fixes, and redacted live OpenRouter proof before another merge-readiness review.

options.title: Extract Quota Work Elsewhere
options.body: Use #86460 as source material for provider-native quota/OpenRouter usage only, then carry those pieces into the chosen Overview dashboard branch.

options.title: Close After Stalled Proof Or Direction
options.body: If the branch remains draft/conflicting without live proof after the current proof window, close it and ask for a narrower replacement.

recommendation.title: Keep #86460 As Candidate After Repair
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but require rebase, the two provider-usage fixes, and redacted live OpenRouter proof before another merge-readiness review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the overlapping #77774 dashboard direction and has recent provider quota/auth-status history on the affected UI and gateway surfaces.
